articles.title: What Canada’s Military Plans Mean for Lockheed, Defense Stocks.
articles.mainIdea: What Canada’s Military Plans Mean for Lockheed, Defense Stocks.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: What Canada’s Military Plans Mean for Lockheed, Defense Stocks.. Relations between the U.S. and its neighbor to the North have been a little rocky lately, even outside hockey arenas. Canada recently released its “Defense Industrial Strategy,” a 58-page document that lays out the country’s vision of the world and its implications for national defense and weapons procurement. “The world has become more volatile and dangerous, and it is more important than ever that Canada be ready and able to defend our territory, our people, and our values,” the document begins. Related tickers mentioned: LHX, LMT.
